scope: Reduce the space used by reply navigation
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--reply-sections-compact-dar.task: Move through reply sections using a concise outline that preserves content width.
conversation--reply-sections-compact-dar.observations: The navigator occupies one small disclosure row; the first heading and body text retain the full reading column. At 760 px navigation stays above the scrollable reply and does not overlap the composer. Dark appearance has clear text and focus contrast.

conversation--reply-sections-desktop-dar.observations: The navigator occupies one small disclosure row; the first heading and body text retain the full reading column.
